svg.title: Illustrative model priors with mock values

cc:Work.dc:title: Illustrative model priors with mock values
cc:Work.dc:description: Five beta prior distributions use mock numerical inputs for a public example. Actual hospital data and original model priors are not shown. Shading represents the central ninety percent prior range.
